description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): approve a pending device, change its name, tags, routes or exit-node setting, or remove it (POST /api/v1/devices/:id/approve, PATCH /api/v1/devices/:id, DELETE /api/v1/devices/:id) as connect.device@1. Removal revokes the mesh key at the control plane at once; an approval never admits a device to another tenant. Pre-auth keys and WireGuard keys are never returned or logged.
